QR Code generator by Project Nayuki, version 1.8.0.

Source: https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator/tree/v1.8.0/c
Files: qrcodegen.c and qrcodegen.h, unchanged.
License: MIT; the complete notice is included in both source files.

The login service limits QR generation to version 12 and renders integer-sized
modules with a four-module quiet zone. No network or platform API is used by the encoder.
